suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: 60-min float
suggested_services.example: The main story: a 60-minute float, $79, paid in full when booking. Sauna suites and cryotherapy are paid this way too.

suggested_services.name: contrast suite (sauna and cold plunge)
suggested_services.example: A $65 contrast suite for one or two. A card is saved for the $25 late-cancel fee, and it's paid at the front desk.

suggested_services.name: mobile sauna and cold plunge at home
suggested_services.example: The main story: a $650 mobile sauna and cold plunge at a home: a $200 deposit now, and the $450 rest charged to the saved card at DONE, after the visit.

suggested_services.name: wellness day at an office (for 6)
suggested_services.example: A $600 wellness day at an office: a $150 deposit from the host, the rest billed by Rosie after the visit.

extra_services.name: recovery visit at home, paid in full

before_times: new to the studio, or been before (sets the first-float price and the briefing)
one person or two (suites for two)
for flow B: a home, an event or an office, the town, and how many guests
after_time: anything staff should know (first time, nervous in small spaces)
secure_page_only: the waiver, signed by each person (a parent signs for anyone under 18)

the health questions for each service, the studio's own list: pregnancy; a heart condition, high blood pressure or a pacemaker; seizures; open wounds or a skin infection; a tattoo or hair dye in the last 2 weeks (float); cold allergy, poor circulation in the hands or feet (cryotherapy); alcohol or drugs today
a doctor's written OK where an answer needs one under the studio's rule
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs; each guest at a mobile sauna or a wellness day fills their own forms

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, a seizure, someone not answering in a float room or sauna

go_on.words: pregnant, a heart condition, high blood pressure, a pacemaker, seizures
go_on.what: the health questions decide which services may be booked, by the studio's own list; some need a doctor's written OK; Rosie gives no medical advice

go_on.words: a burn, a cold burn or a rash after a session
go_on.what: the studio's own line; staff give first aid; 911 if it's serious

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and health questions
steps.when: on the secure page while booking, before the first visit, again each year and whenever health changes
steps.who: every person who uses a service; a parent signs for anyone under 18; each guest at a mobile sauna or wellness day signs their own
steps.result: all clear: it books; an answer the studio's list rules out: another service or no booking, before any money; an answer that needs a doctor's OK: it books only once the OK is on file

steps.name: Doctor's written OK
steps.when: before the session, where the studio's rule asks for one (pregnancy for a float, a heart condition for the sauna)
steps.who: the customer brings or uploads it
steps.result: on file: it goes ahead; not in: another service, or a move with no fee

steps.name: Blood pressure check
steps.when: at the front desk right before each cryotherapy session
steps.result: under the studio's limit: the session goes ahead; over: no cryotherapy today, another service or a refund

steps.name: First-visit briefing
steps.when: at the start of a first float or cryotherapy session, 5 minutes
steps.result: staff show how the room or chamber works

first_steps_and_forms.prep: no alcohol that day; eat lightly 1 hour before; for a float, no shaving that day and no new tattoo or hair dye in the last 2 weeks; for cryotherapy, dry skin and no lotion

staff.skills: front desk, float rooms, cryotherapy operator (trained by the maker), sauna and plunge, mobile sauna driver and setup
staff.supervision: a trained cryotherapy operator in the room for every session; at least one CPR-trained staff member on duty whenever rooms are booked
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs fees, refunds and mobile bookings, and decides which health answers need a doctor's OK
staff.stand_in: no person is named; any trained staff member on duty runs a session

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs; each guest at a mobile sauna or a wellness day fills their own forms
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian
children_and_age.minors_rules: minimum ages by service, the studio's own rule and the state's where it has one

visit.check_in: at the front desk: the check-in code; for cryotherapy, the blood pressure check first; at a mobile sauna or a wellness day (flow B): each guest's own code on the host's list
visit.done: the check-in code; for flow B, DONE from the staff member after pack-up
visit.changes_at_visit: a session ended early for safety is done another way or refunded for the part not given; an added session is priced first and needs a free room
visit.before_work: staff check the health questions are done for each person, show first-timers the room, and for cryotherapy check dry skin, gloves, socks and slippers

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: no state license for float, sauna or cryotherapy in most places; a local health permit where the local rules treat float tanks, plunge pools or saunas as pools or spas (the business's own permit, shown as its word; none is checked by Rosie, D96)
license.who: the business, for its registration and any local health permit it chooses to show
license.ask: optional: the business registration and any local permit it wants shown; nothing is asked of each attendant
license.insurance: general liability insurance is optional: the business's own word; host places and events may ask to see it, and the business shows it there

never_in_a_text: health answers, blood pressure readings, a doctor's OK and a child's details never go in a text: only the secure page
